slides.title: The wealth desks have arrived.
slides.sub: A national wealth firm just opened a Hyderabad desk for families with ₹5 crore or more. That says more about us than about them.

slides.label: The news
slides.text: Godrej Wealth has opened a Hyderabad desk for clients with ₹5 crore or more in investable assets.

slides.label: What it really means
slides.text: This city made its money in plots and flats. Very little of it was ever planned. Someone finally noticed.

slides.title: Questions most families never ask
items: How much of my net worth is just property?
If I needed cash in 12 months, could I get it?
Did anyone check the papers, or did we trust the seller?

slides.title: What I've seen
slides.text: The families who lost money didn't buy bad land. They bought too much of it, too fast, with no exit.

slides.title: Owning a lot is not the same as being wealthy.
slides.text: Count what you can sell, not what you own.
